brief:
At least 350 humanitarian workers died in 2025, with the majority killed in Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. The deaths represent a significant toll among aid personnel operating across conflict zones in the region.

Fighting in Gaza continued throughout the year, creating hazardous conditions for those delivering relief assistance. Aid organizations have faced mounting obstacles in reaching civilians in need of food, medicine, and shelter.
title: Humanitarian workers killed in Gaza surge in 2025
